Class Vehicle

java.lang.Object
Renderable
Vehicle
All Implemented Interfaces:
Updatable
public class Vehicle extends Renderable implements Updatable
Represents a vehicle in the traffic simulation. Type is determined from ID prefix (car, truck, bus, moto, ambu). Extends Renderable and implements Updatable for SUMO updates.

2.0
